notes: Scope: independent self-test re-run of build-report.md's developer gate (build complete through commit 8516451) plus end-to-end behavioral verification of CR-001 against a really-running server (server:4000, client:5173, Vite dev) with the demo seed loaded.

All developer-scoped commands were re-run from a clean checkout state and all match or reproduce the build-report's recorded results: server unit 6 files/81 tests, server integration 10 files/74 tests, client (excl. qa) 17 files/99 tests, server coverage 97/92.28/99.08/97 (thresholds 70/60/70/70), client coverage 85.42/83.56/82.92/85.42 (thresholds 70/60/70/70), build clean, smoke 17/17.

QA-owned suites (server/tests/qa/**, client/tests/qa/**) were intentionally NOT run as part of this developer gate and are NOT counted as developer failures — they assert the pre-CR-001 contract (/budgets/:month, 5 categories, current+previous insights) and are QA's to update this iteration per docs/workflow/source-of-truth.md file-ownership rules. They are recorded above as a single not_applicable acceptance check (QA-OWNED-SUITES-EXCLUDED) and enumerated in full for the orchestrator/QA to route, per developer/build-report.md.

Playwright environment note: the sandboxed network intercepts TLS with a self-signed certificate, so `npx playwright install` could not download a fresh Chromium build. The self-test instead launched Playwright against the already-cached 'Google Chrome for Testing' build (chromium-1228) via an explicit executablePath — functionally equivalent for this UI verification (navigation, clicks, keyboard, screenshots, computed styles). No product code or config was changed to work around this; it is purely a local tooling choice for this test run.

Console findings during the full Playwright pass: (1) a benign 401 on GET /auth/me from the login page's session probe — present in delivery-1 too, not a regression; (2) a 404 for /favicon.ico — the app has no favicon.ico file (only client/public/logo.svg), so the browser's automatic favicon probe 404s; cosmetic, unrelated to CR-001, not a functional defect. No other console or page errors were observed across Budget, Insights, Login at 1440/390/320.

A transient run of the Playwright add-expense step (mid-session, before the script's wait logic was hardened for Neon's multi-second mutation latency) left one stray 'Self-test expense' (50.00, category subscriptions) undeleted in the demo user's current-month data. This was detected via the hero total (8,470 instead of 8,420) on the next run, the demo data was re-seeded (ALLOW_DEMO_SEED=true npm run seed:demo) to restore the canonical 842000/918000 totals, and the final, hardened Playwright run (42/42 passed) confirms clean add-then-delete recalculation with zero residue. Verified clean via curl afterward: GET /budget income=1250000/utilities plannedMinor=120000, GET /months/2026-07 actualMinor=842000.

All commands, screenshots, and API captures are stored under .workflow/sprints/delivery-2/iteration-01/developer/evidence/selftest/ (commands/, api-checks/, and 10 PNG screenshots + selftest-results.json from the Playwright run).

Dev server (port 4000), Vite (port 5173), and the demo-user cookie session used for curl checks were all torn down at the end of self-test; verified no process listening on 4000/5173 and no stray Chrome-for-Testing process afterward. No product code was modified during this test-only phase.
